title: A copy that cannot fit a shared refusal serves nothing cached and undoes nothing
notes: The copy 'peer' loads both skills and reads a file of each, then sits at exactly 65,536 characters. The registry it was copied from registers docs again, which now offers docs:guide in a form this host does not take, and retires kb:tips on a failed file check, its entry read again in that form too. Following either update would put a longer reason in the copy's manifest: each read in the copy fails with the manifest-size error, its cached skill and file are not served, and its record is as it was. The other registry keeps both updates.
